Read this file, never the core sources. Site sections: `grep -h @catalog components/sections/*.tsx`.

## Tokens (Tailwind classes generated from design.dna.ts)

- Colors (bg-, text-, border-, ring-, fill-): `surface`, `surface-2`, `surface-3`, `ink`, `ink-muted`, `line`, `rule`,
  `accent` (fills) + `accent-ink` (text on accent), `accent-text` (accent as text, AA on surfaces), `secondary` (sparingly).
  Opacity modifiers work (`text-surface/80`). Inverse blocks: `bg-ink text-surface`.
- Type: `font-display`, `font-body`, `font-mono`; `text-display-2xl`, `text-display-xl`, `text-display-lg`, `text-heading`,
  `text-subheading`, `text-body-lg` (line height and tracking included).
- Layout: `py-section` (DNA density), `px-gutter`, `max-w-content`, `max-w-prose`; corners `rounded-card`, `rounded-control`,
  `rounded-media`; rules `rule-t`, `rule-b` (width and color from the DNA).
- Motion: `duration-(--duration-brand) ease-brand`. Textures: `texture-grain`, `texture-halftone`, `texture-grid`, `texture-mesh`.
- `<html>` carries `data-archetype`, `data-motion`, `data-three`, `data-texture`, `data-radius` for variant styling.
- Scroll motion (pure CSS, off for reduced motion and DNA motion none): `reveal`, `reveal-fade`, `reveal-scale`,
  `reveal-stagger` (children; index via `style={stagger(i)}` from @dss/motion), `parallax`, `marquee`, `split-words`.

| Container: centered column with the DNA gutter. | size: content (default, DNA width) \| prose (reading measure) \| full; as |
| Section: vertical rhythm block. Space comes from DNA density; tone swaps the palette. | tone: surface \| raised \| inverse \| accent; space: section (default) \| tight \| none; rule (top rule); id |
| Stack: vertical flow with consistent gaps. | gap: xs \| sm \| md (default) \| lg \| xl; as |
| Cluster: wrapping row (actions, tags, logos). | gap: sm \| md (default) \| lg; align: start \| center \| between |
| Grid: responsive columns. Prefer asymmetric spans (md:col-span-*) for editorial layouts. | cols: 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 12; gap: md (default) \| lg |

| Text: body copy. Muted tone keeps WCAG AA on surface and surface-2. | size: sm \| base (default) \| lg; tone: ink (default) \| muted; as: p \| span \| div |
| Eyebrow: small label above a heading. Sentence case by default (all-caps eyebrows are a generated-site tell). | caps (opt-in uppercase with tracking) |
| Prose: long-form rich text (MDX, legal pages) at reading measure. |  |

## Motion and 3D (`@dss/motion`, client `@dss/motion/count-up`; `@dss/three` only in components/3d)

| Component | Props |
|---|---|
| CountUp (client): animates a number from 0 when it enters the viewport; renders the final value without JS or with reduced motion. Keep the label outside. | value (number), prefix?, suffix?, duration? (ms) |
| Marquee: infinite horizontal loop in CSS (pauses on hover, static when motion is off). Logos, kinetic words. | children (one sequence; it is duplicated), label (accessible name), className |
| SplitWords: headline revealed word by word in CSS (server-rendered, no JS). Use once per page, on the hero. | text, as (h1 \| h2 \| p...), className |
| Scene (client): lazy three.js canvas with poster fallback; never the LCP element. Use inside components/3d only. | load, poster, label, className, dpr, minWidth (default 768: phones keep the poster) |

Scenes (`pnpm dss add scene <id>`, copied into components/3d/, poster fallback, skipped when DNA three is none):

- `gradient` (GradientScene): Full-canvas shader in DNA colors, very light GPU cost. Poster: surface-2 with texture-mesh.
- `particles` (ParticlesScene): 1,400 points on a sphere shell in the DNA accent, pointer parallax. Poster: surface-2 with texture-halftone.

## Modules (`pnpm dss module add <slug>`; read `core/modules/<slug>/README.md` after adding)

- `analytics`: Cookieless audience measurement (Plausible, Umami or Cloudflare Web Analytics), production builds only, no consent banner needed.
- `blog`: Markdown articles in content/blog: index, article pages with Article JSON-LD, RSS, sitemap and llms.txt entries.

- `legal`: Legal notice and privacy policy (GDPR, Swiss nLPD) pages linked from the footer, structured placeholders to fill.
- Database: `pnpm dss db init [--driver d1|libsql|postgres]` (schema in server/db/schema.ts, `db()` from server/db/client.ts).

## Archetypes (design.dna.ts `archetype`)

- **editorial**: a considered publication: big serif headlines, generous measure, asymmetric columns. Signature: pull quotes, drop caps, captions under images, one oversized headline per page. Avoid: card grids, icons in circles, centered everything.
- **swiss**: rational grid, flush-left grotesk, one strong signal color, numbers and alignment do the talking. Signature: visible grid, large index numbers, strict baseline, a single red/blue/yellow accent. Avoid: rounded pills, gradients, decorative serif.
- **brutalist**: raw and confident: heavy type, thick borders, system-like layout, high contrast. Signature: thick black rules, marquee text, exposed structure, offset hard shadows. Avoid: soft shadows, pastel gradients, delicate serif.
- **luxury**: restraint and space: high-contrast serif, slow reveals, a muted precious accent. Signature: huge whitespace, letter-spaced small caps, full-bleed imagery, slow fades. Avoid: bright saturated accents, dense copy, bouncy motion.
- **organic**: natural and tactile: earthy palette, soft shapes, paper texture, unhurried rhythm. Signature: organic blob crops, hand-drawn underline, warm off-white surfaces. Avoid: neon, hard black, tech grids.
- **tech-noir**: dark interface aesthetic: mono labels, fine grid lines, one luminous accent, product-first. Signature: terminal-like labels, code snippets, live-looking UI fragments, subtle 3D. Avoid: purple-to-pink gradients, glassmorphism cards, emoji.
- **playful**: cheerful and bold: rounded type, saturated colors, stickers and bouncy motion. Signature: sticker-like badges, tilted cards, color-blocked sections, springy hovers. Avoid: thin serif, grey-on-grey, corporate stock photos.
- **retro-print**: printed-matter nostalgia: slab and fat-face type, halftone, warm inks on cream. Signature: badges and stamps, two-ink color scheme, misregistered offsets. Avoid: glossy gradients, thin geometric sans.
- **minimal-mono**: almost nothing: monospace-led, monochrome, one tiny accent, content as structure. Signature: plain-text lists, timestamps, keyboard-like links, generous line height. Avoid: hero images, decorative illustration, more than one accent.
- **magazine**: newsstand energy: condensed display, dense multi-column layout, big numbers and covers. Signature: cover-style hero, issue numbers, kicker labels, tight leading headlines. Avoid: empty minimalism, pastel palettes.
- **architectural**: space and proportion: thin type, wide margins, full-bleed photography, slow motion. Signature: plan-like line drawings, image sequences, coordinates and dimensions as details. Avoid: bright accents, illustration, playful motion.
- **kinetic-type**: typography as image: oversized moving headlines, variable fonts, scroll-driven motion. Signature: viewport-wide words, variable weight on scroll, marquees, split-letter reveals. Avoid: static stock imagery, small timid headlines.
- **craft**: made by hand: documentary photos, warm serif, process stories, tactile details. Signature: process timelines with real photos, handwritten notes, maker portraits. Avoid: stock photos of smiling people, glossy UI.
- **institutional**: quiet authority: classic serif, deep sober color, clear hierarchy, proof over promises. Signature: credentials and figures up front, named people, precise service lists. Avoid: handshake stock photos, gavel icons, vague superlatives.
